lines.en: label mollycafe20:
scene seconddnd1
I swing open the door to the cafe and quickly stumble onto the fact that tonight will be exponentially louder than I expected.
lines.zh: 我推开门走进咖啡馆，很快就发现今晚的吵闹程度远远超出我的预期。

lines.en: And considering I came here to see Molly, the expectation for noise was already pretty high.
lines.zh: 而考虑到我是来看 Molly 的，我对噪音的预期本来就已经相当高了。

lines.en: Is it really okay for them to be playing this in the cafe, though? I can’t imagine Haruka signed off on this.
lines.zh: 不过他们真的可以在咖啡馆里玩这个吗？我实在想象不出 Haruka 会批准这种事。

lines.en: : Ohoho~ It appears we have ourselves a new player!
lines.zh: : 哦嚯嚯～看来我们来了一位新玩家！

lines.en: : Take a seat, Sir! I shall help you create a character!
lines.zh: : 请坐，先生！我来帮您创建角色！

lines.en: : Uhh, no. I’m good.
lines.zh: : 呃，不用了。我就算了。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you all had plans to play here tonight.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你们今晚打算在这儿玩这个。

lines.en: : But I literally texted you about this exact thing happening.
lines.zh: : 可我明明发短信跟你说过就是这么回事啊。

lines.en: : Yes, but I stopped reading the second I saw words I didn’t understand.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我一看到看不懂的词就不往下读了。

lines.en: scene seconddnd2
: What if what I had to say was important?!
lines.zh: : 万一我要说的事很重要呢？！

lines.en: : What if I was being kidnapped and didn’t have time to think of words you like?!
lines.zh: : 万一我正被人绑架，没时间想你会喜欢的词呢？！

lines.en: : Then you’d probably be in someone’s trunk right now.
lines.zh: : 那你现在大概已经在谁的后备箱里了。

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to play, Sir? We could use someone with your alignment.
lines.zh: : 您确定不玩吗，先生？我们正需要您这种阵营的人。

lines.en: : My...what?
lines.zh: : 我的……什么？

lines.en: : Neutral evil, Sir. That’s how I see your character.
lines.zh: : 中立邪恶，先生。我是这么给您的角色定位的。

lines.en: : Evil? Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 邪恶？绝对不是。

lines.en: : Sensei is lawful good. He’d never do anything to hurt anyone and always stands up for what is right.
lines.zh: : Sensei 是守序善良。他绝不会做任何伤害别人的事，而且永远站在正义一边。

lines.en: scene seconddnd3
: I don’t think he’s {i}lawful{/i} good but maybe...neutral good?
lines.zh: : 我不觉得他是{i}守序{/i}善良，不过也许是……中立善良？

lines.en: : His intentions aren’t always clear but I don’t think he’s a bad guy.
lines.zh: : 他的意图不总是那么清晰，但我觉得他不是坏人。

lines.en: : Ayane! Stop saying you’re in love with my [uncle]!
lines.zh: : Ayane！别再说你爱上我的[uncle]了！

lines.en: : How do you see yourself, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那您自己怎么看呢，Sensei？

lines.en: : I don’t even know what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我根本不知道你们在说什么。

lines.en: : That’s okay...neither did Tsuneyo and...we helped her figure it out.
lines.zh: : 没关系……Tsuneyo 一开始也不懂，后来我们帮她弄明白了。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo? Is she here?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo？她也在这儿？

lines.en: : Behind you.
lines.zh: : 在你背后。

lines.en: scene seconddnd4
: My alignment is noodle evil.
lines.zh: : 我的阵营是面条邪恶。

lines.en: : {i}Neutral evil{/i}, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 是{i}中立邪恶{/i}，剑道公主。

lines.en: : Noodle evil.
lines.zh: : 面条邪恶。

lines.en: : Do you understand what they’re talking about?
lines.zh: : 你听懂她们在说什么了吗？

lines.en: : Almost. I seem to have everything very slightly wrong.
lines.zh: : 差不多。我好像每一样都理解得稍微偏了一点点。

lines.en: : That adds up.
lines.zh: : 这就说得通了。

lines.en: : She’ll be able to play once she starts following the rules.
lines.zh: : 等她开始守规则了，就能玩了。

lines.en: : She’s right. I am very bad at this game.
lines.zh: : 她说得对。我玩这游戏特别差。

lines.en: : Well, I guess the two of us can watch together as long as you don’t get drunk and pass out on me again.
lines.zh: : 那我们俩就一起看着吧，只要你不喝醉了又趴在我身上睡着就行。

lines.en: : I will do my very best.
lines.zh: : 我会竭尽全力的。

lines.en: scene seconddnd5
: If anyone wants my input, I think Sensei is chaotic evil. The absolute worst kind of person.
lines.zh: : 要我说的话，我觉得 Sensei 是混乱邪恶。最最糟糕的那一种人。

lines.en: : And I think you’re a nerd.
lines.zh: : 而我觉得你是个书呆子。

lines.en: scene seconddnd6
: Why does everyone keep calling me a nerd?!
lines.zh: : 为什么每个人都管我叫书呆子？！

lines.en: : Ooooh, a critical hit!
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，暴击！

lines.en: : I’m giving Sensei advantage on his next attack as a special bonus for getting Maya to yell.
lines.zh: : 我要给 Sensei 的下一次攻击加上优势，作为他惹得 Maya 大叫的特殊奖励。

lines.en: scene seconddnd7
: Tch!
: It’s okay, Maya. I don’t think you’re a nerd.
lines.zh: : 没事，Maya。我觉得你不是书呆子。

lines.en: : But I do want you to know that a certain rogue might sneak into your room at night and assassinate you for calling her true love evil.
lines.zh: : 但我想让你知道，某个游荡者可能会在夜里溜进你的房间，因为你把她的真爱说成邪恶而暗杀你。

lines.en: : So...you watched the game on the beach...right, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那么……你在海滩上看过那场比赛，对吧，Sensei？

lines.en: : The one I wasn’t around for.
lines.zh: : 就是我没在场的那一次。

lines.en: : I tried to. All I remember is a mushroom.
lines.zh: : 我试着看了。我只记得一朵蘑菇。

lines.en: : Well, never fear, Sir! For I shall be giving a recap of our exploits thus far shortly!
lines.zh: : 别担心，先生！因为我马上就要把我们的冒险历程回顾一遍！

lines.en: : We’ve played...a few more times since then and...you’ve missed a lot.
lines.zh: : 从那以后我们又玩了……好几次，而您错过了很多。

lines.en: : Sana had her arm chopped off.
lines.zh: : Sana 的手臂被砍掉了。

lines.en: : And then I...beat a man to death with it...
lines.zh: : 然后我……用那只手臂把一个人打死了……

lines.en: : Yeah, Sana doesn’t really mess around when it comes to D&D.
lines.zh: : 是啊，一提到《龙与地下城》，Sana 可从不含糊。

lines.en: : Okay, well I’m going to sit down now.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我先坐下了。

lines.en: scene seconddnd8
: They never chose an alignment for you.
lines.zh: : 他们一直没给你选阵营。

lines.en: : Allow me to do it instead.
lines.zh: : 那就让我来替你选吧。

lines.en: : I declare you...
lines.zh: : 我宣布你是……

lines.en: : True noodle.
lines.zh: : 真·面条。

lines.en: : I declare you weird.
lines.zh: : 我宣布你很怪。

lines.en: : I declare my feelings hurt.
lines.zh: : 我宣布我的感情受到了伤害。

lines.en: : Please never talk to me again.
lines.zh: : 请你以后再也不要跟我说话了。

lines.en: : Can I treat you to ramen to win you back?
lines.zh: : 我能请你吃碗拉面，好挽回你的心吗？

lines.en: scene seconddnd9
: I will not allow myself to be bought off like this.
lines.zh: : 我可不会让自己就这么被收买。

lines.en: scene seconddnd10
: Okay! That’s enough idle chit chat! The time has come for our journey to continue!
lines.zh: : 好了！闲话就聊到这儿！我们继续冒险的时刻到了！

lines.en: : We only have two hours until the Magistrate of Mammaries returns to the cafe and scolds all of us for taking up an entire section of the store without buying anything!
lines.zh: : 再过两个小时「巨乳司政官」就要回咖啡馆了，到时她会因为我们占了店里一整片位置却什么都没买，而把大家骂一顿！

lines.en: : I’m a big fan of the nickname you chose for Haruka. It's very fitting.
lines.zh: : 我可太喜欢你给 Haruka 起的这个外号了。非常贴切。

lines.en: : Don’t you think it would be a little better for Futaba, though? I think hers are bigger.
lines.zh: : 不过你不觉得用在 Futaba 身上更合适一点吗？我觉得她的更大。

lines.en: : Futaba, what size bra do you wear? Like X?
lines.zh: : Futaba，你穿多大罩杯？X 罩杯吗？

lines.en: : I...don’t think it goes that high...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得应该没到那么高……

lines.en: : Enough!
lines.zh: : 够了！

lines.en: scene seconddnd11
: When we last left off, we discovered that a powerful Illithid by the name of Thaum had emerged from the Underdark with a small army of thralls at their disposal.
lines.zh: : 上次我们讲到，一位名叫 Thaum 的强大夺心魔从幽暗地域现身，手下还带着一支可供驱使的小规模奴仆大军。

lines.en: : The party, sensing it had to unite or face a rather untimely and premature level two demise, banded together to force back the thralls.
lines.zh: : 冒险小队意识到，要么团结起来，要么就在二级时迎来一场过早的夭折，于是众人联手击退了那些奴仆。

lines.en: scene seconddnd12
: But not before the loss of Zagull Throat Spear’s arm.
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，Zagull Throat Spear 失去了自己的一条手臂。

lines.en: : Without anyone able to help Zagull regenerate said arm and Thaum retreating to do more evil psion stuff...
lines.zh: : 由于没人能帮 Zagull 重生那条手臂，而 Thaum 也退回去捣鼓更多邪恶的灵能勾当……

lines.en: : The party headed to the nearby city of Frostford for some much needed rest and...hopefully an experienced healer.
lines.zh: : 小队便动身前往附近的城市霜渡，去好好休整一番……也希望能找到一位经验丰富的治疗师。

lines.en: scene seconddnd13
: Despite its name, Frostford is a coastal, port city that is home to one of the biggest alchemical colleges in all of the land.
lines.zh: : 尽管名字里带个「霜」字，霜渡却是一座沿海的港口城市，坐拥全大陆最大的炼金学院之一。

lines.en: : So it’s no surprise when you see the streets lined with [young]alchemists, their noses buried deep in books, studying their hearts out to prepare for upcoming exams.
lines.zh: : 所以当你看到街上到处都是[young]炼金术士，个个把鼻子埋进书里、为即将到来的考试拼命苦读时，也就不足为奇了。

lines.en: : It’s the end of a semester and the city is bustling with uncertainty and energy.
lines.zh: : 正值学期末，整座城市涌动着不安与活力。

lines.en: : The perfect time to talk to anyone you want or, better yet, ask them anything you’re still curious about.
lines.zh: : 这是找任何人搭话的绝佳时机，或者更好的是，把你仍然好奇的事问个清楚。

lines.en: : Your party still has no clear goal as you took a wrong turn and ran into Thaum long before you were supposed to, so things could really go anywhere from here.
lines.zh: : 你们小队至今仍没有明确目标，因为你们拐错了路，远远早于预定时间就撞上了 Thaum，所以接下来发生什么都有可能。

lines.en: scene seconddnd14
: So, what do you guys wanna do?
lines.zh: : 那么，你们想做点什么？

lines.en: : Like I said, there’s no goal right now and you still don’t know why you all woke up next to one another, so it’s probably a good idea to go out and find a...reason to exist or something.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的，现在没有目标，你们也还不知道为什么醒来时会彼此躺在旁边，所以最好还是出去找个……存在的理由什么的。

lines.en: scene seconddnd15
: Sana, how important is it for you to get your arm back?
lines.zh: : Sana，把胳膊弄回来对你来说有多重要？

lines.en: : I kind of like only having one arm...
lines.zh: : 我其实还挺喜欢只有一条胳膊的……

lines.en: : It makes me look strong and...I’m able to wield my greataxe with one hand.
lines.zh: : 这样看起来更强……而且我能单手挥舞我的巨斧。

lines.en: : You’ll still have disadvantage though, so...just saying.
lines.zh: : 不过你还是会处于劣势，所以……我就随口一说。

lines.en: : Okay, but what matters more to you? Looking cool or killing people?
lines.zh: : 好吧，那对你来说哪个更重要？看起来帅，还是杀人？

lines.en: : That’s...umm...
: Actually, don’t let Sana think about that. What would {i}Zagull{/i} want?
lines.zh: : 那个，别让 Sana 想这个了。{i}Zagull{/i} 会怎么想？

lines.en: scene seconddnd16
: Zagull will...bathe in the blood of his enemies no matter the circumstances!
lines.zh: : Zagull 无论何种情况……都会在敌人的血海中沐浴！

lines.en: : He only needs one arm to drain the life from his opponents!
lines.zh: : 他只需要一条胳膊，就能吸干对手的生命！

lines.en: scene seconddnd17
: Well...while Nithhala and Zagull are trying to figure out the arm thing, do you think maybe the rest of us should head to a tavern or something?
lines.zh: : 嗯……趁 Nithhala 和 Zagull 还在纠结胳膊的事，我们其他人要不要先去趟酒馆什么的？

lines.en: : Is your wizard also an alcoholic?
lines.zh: : 你的法师也是个酒鬼吗？

lines.en: scene seconddnd18
: What? No. Just...that’s where you normally go to pick up quests and stuff.
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。只是……那种地方通常能接到任务什么的。

lines.en: : That’s true. Innkeepers always seem to know the latest gossip in fantasy novels.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。奇幻小说里的旅店老板好像总是知道最新的小道消息。

lines.en: scene seconddnd14
: So you three are going to head to the tavern?
lines.zh: : 那你们三个要去酒馆？

lines.en: : Yes. Arborea needs to get her fix.
lines.zh: : 对。Arborea 需要解解瘾。

lines.en: : I do not! I’m just looking for some sort of goal so we don’t wander around town until we grow old and die!
lines.zh: : 才不是！我只是想找点目标，免得我们在城里瞎逛到老死为止！

lines.en: : Oooookay! Arborea, Urrheak and Xessaxia-
lines.zh: : 好——吧！Arborea、Urrheak 和 Xessaxia——

lines.en: : You’re lucky enough to come across a signpost pointing you directly toward the tavern immediately after entering the city limits.
lines.zh: : 你们运气不错，刚一进城界就看到一块路牌，直直地指向酒馆。

lines.en: : It appears to be only a short walk from here, so you should be able to get there in no time at all.
lines.zh: : 看起来离这儿只有一小段路，所以你们应该转眼就能到。

lines.en: scene seconddnd19
: Nithhala and Zagull, are you going to the tavern as well?
lines.zh: : Nithhala 和 Zagull，你们也去酒馆吗？

lines.en: : Huh? Oh, yeah. We’ll go.
lines.zh: : 啊？哦，对。我们也去。

lines.en: : Zagull isn’t convinced that he wants his arm reattached yet.
lines.zh: : Zagull 还没想好要不要把手臂接回去。

lines.en: : But Zagull {i}could{/i} go for a tall glass of mead! Bahahaha!
lines.zh: : 但 Zagull 倒是{i}可以{/i}来一大杯蜂蜜酒！哇哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Okay! So the five of you begin to make your way to the tavern-
lines.zh: : 好的！于是你们五人开始往酒馆走去——

lines.en: scene seconddnd20
: Wait a second, I haven’t said what I wanted to do yet.
lines.zh: : 等一下，我还没说我想做什么呢。

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. Lots of people. Trying to keep track of everything.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。人太多了。我正努力把一切都记全。

lines.en: : What is Lidearel doing?
lines.zh: : 那 Lidearel 要做什么？

lines.en: : She’s gonna go with everyone because she gets lonely easily.
lines.zh: : 她会跟大家一起去，因为她很容易寂寞。

lines.en: : But she’s also going to try and pickpocket the first man she sees.
lines.zh: : 不过她还打算扒遇到的第一个男人的口袋。

lines.en: : You see a lot of men. It’s a relatively busy city.
lines.zh: : 你看到很多男人。这城市算是挺热闹的。

lines.en: : Are there any gnomes?
lines.zh: : 有侏儒吗？

lines.en: : There are not.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Tieflings?
lines.zh: : 提夫林呢？

lines.en: : Apart from Nithhala? No.
lines.zh: : 除了 Nithhala？没有。

lines.en: : I’m just going to try to pickpocket Nithhala then.
lines.zh: : 那我就去扒 Nithhala 的口袋好了。

lines.en: : Dude.
: I won’t keep anything. I just want to assert dominance.
lines.zh: : 我不会拿走任何东西。我只是想宣示一下主导地位。

lines.en: : Steal from Zagull. He’s only got one arm.
lines.zh: : 那去偷 Zagull 的。他只有一条胳膊。

lines.en: : Yeah but that arm is bigger than my entire body. I’m going to pickpocket Nithhala.
lines.zh: : 是，可那条胳膊比我整个人都大。我还是要扒 Nithhala。

lines.en: scene seconddnd21
: This is fun...
lines.zh: : 这还挺好玩的……

lines.en: : Easy for you to say. You killed someone with your arm.
lines.zh: : 你说得轻巧。你可是用手臂打死过人的。

lines.en: : I mean...it's kind of an unwritten rule to not do things like this...but roll sleight of hand, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我是说……这种事算是某种不成文的禁忌……不过你还是掷个巧手检定吧。

lines.en: : Woo! Just gonna grab my dice and...
lines.zh: : 哇哦！我这就去拿骰子……

lines.en: : That’s an...18.
: Oof. Okay. Rin, roll perception to see if you catch her.
lines.zh: : 哎哟。好吧。Rin，掷个察觉检定，看你有没有抓到她。

lines.en: : Why? We all know what it’s going to be.
lines.zh: : 干嘛？结果会是什么大家心里都有数。

lines.en: : So you’re just going to ignore her pickpocket attempt?
lines.zh: : 也就是说，你就打算无视她的扒窃了？

lines.en: : Ugh, fine.
lines.zh: : 唉，好吧。

lines.en: scene seconddnd22
: Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana。
: ……什么事？

lines.en: : Can you blow on my dice for good luck?
lines.zh: : 你能不能对着我的骰子吹口气，给我加点好运？

lines.en: : Is that...a thing people do?
lines.zh: : 这……是有人会做的事吗？

lines.en: : I think so?
lines.zh: : 我想是吧？

lines.en: scene seconddnd23
: {i}Hoooo...{/i}
: So cute...
lines.zh: : 好可爱……

lines.en: scene seconddnd24
: OKAY! Thanks, Sana! With your blessing, there’s no way I can lose!
lines.zh: : 好嘞！谢了，Sana！有你的祝福，我绝对不可能输！

lines.en: scene seconddnd25
scene seconddnd26
: There there...
lines.zh: : 好了好了……

lines.en: scene seconddnd27
: Nithhala rolled a 5 for anyone who didn’t see. Which means Lidearel is able to successfully reach her hands into Nithhala’s pockets and find...
lines.zh: : 没看清的人注意一下，Nithhala 掷出了 5。也就是说 Lidearel 成功把手伸进了 Nithhala 的口袋，摸到了……

lines.en: : Woo! What did I get?!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！我摸到了什么？！

lines.en: : Absolutely nothing.
lines.zh: : 什么都没有。

lines.en: : You didn’t start with any items and Nithhala’s bag is completely empty.
lines.zh: : 你一开始就没有物品，而 Nithhala 的包完全是空的。

lines.en: : Since you rolled an 18, though, we can assume that you just successfully groped her without being noticed.
lines.zh: : 不过既然你掷出了 18，我们可以认为你神不知鬼不觉地成功摸了她一把。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, that’s better than nothing, I guess.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，那总比什么都没有强吧。

lines.en: scene seconddnd28
: Are you having a good time?
lines.zh: : 你还玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : Are you?
lines.zh: : 你呢？

lines.en: : I think so.
lines.zh: : 我想是吧。

lines.en: : Everyone else is having a good time, so I think I’m supposed to be having one as well.
lines.zh: : 其他人都玩得很开心，所以我觉得自己也该开心才对。

lines.en: : I’m very confused, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我很困惑。

lines.en: : You and me both.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : What’s so fun about deciding success based on dice rolls?
lines.zh: : 用掷骰子来决定成败，到底有什么好玩的？

lines.en: : Perhaps there is a certain ingrained desire in all of us to allow chance to rule our lives?...So that we do not have ourselves to blame when things don’t go our way.
lines.zh: : 也许我们每个人骨子里都有一种欲望，想让偶然来主宰自己的人生？……这样当事与愿违时，我们就不必怪罪自己了。

lines.en: : Or maybe they just like dice.
lines.zh: : 也可能她们就是喜欢骰子。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I’m not allowed to play.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我又不许下场玩。

lines.en: scene seconddnd29
: So, after Lidearel feels up her tiefling companion, she and the rest of the group make their way to the local tavern.
lines.zh: : 于是，在 Lidearel 把她的提夫林同伴上下其手一番之后，她和其他人一起动身前往当地的酒馆。

lines.en: : It’s a large building situated in the center of the city with an ornate wooden archway towering over a beautiful pair of dwarven, hand carved doors.
lines.zh: : 那是一栋坐落在城市中心的大型建筑，一座雕饰华美的木质拱门高耸其上，下面是一对精美绝伦的矮人手工雕刻大门。

lines.en: : But, before you’re able to enter, the doors swing open and out flies a young, half elf woman.
lines.zh: : 可你们还没来得及进去，大门就猛地敞开，一个年轻的半精灵女子从里面飞了出来。

lines.en: : She falls flat on her face, but quickly regains her composure and scurries backward.
lines.zh: : 她重重地摔了个狗啃泥，但很快镇定下来，手脚并用地往后退去。

lines.en: : Her clothes are tattered and torn...and look as if they haven’t been washed even once in her life.
lines.zh: : 她的衣服破破烂烂……看起来这辈子从没洗过一次。

lines.en: scene seconddnd30
: {i}Back! Back, I say!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}退后！我说，退后！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You’re...you're all here to laugh at me as well, aren’t you?!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你们……你们也是来笑话我的，对吧？！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}That’s all they ever do in this town! Laugh, laugh, laugh!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这座城里的人只会干这个！笑啊，笑啊，笑！{/i}

lines.en: scene seconddnd31
: The woman brandishes a golden dagger with a silver inlay on the handle, one that looks far too valuable for her to own, and points it directly at Arborea.
lines.zh: : 那女人举起一把刀柄镶银的黄金匕首，那玩意儿看着远不像她这种人能拥有的，然后将刀尖直指 Arborea。

lines.en: : Wait, me? What did I do?
lines.zh: : 等等，我？我做什么了？

lines.en: : Is that {i}in{/i} character or out of character?
lines.zh: : 这是角色{i}内{/i}发言还是角色外发言？

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh, both I guess?
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，大概都有吧？

lines.en: : Cool. I’m just going to keep roleplaying then.
lines.zh: : 酷。那我就继续扮演下去了。

lines.en: scene seconddnd32
: {i}You...You think I don’t know who you are?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你……你以为我不知道你是谁？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}You’re the same woman who turned me away in the last tavern!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你就是上一家酒馆里把我赶出去的那个女人！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}None of you ever listen! Thaum is...Thaum is coming!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你们谁都不肯听！Thaum 要……Thaum 要来了！{/i}

lines.en: scene seconddnd33
: Surely, you jest.
lines.zh: : 您一定是在说笑吧。

lines.en: : If you speak of the mind flayer, we made quick work of him on our way into town.
lines.zh: : 如果您说的是那只夺心魔，我们在进城路上就已经干脆利落地解决了它。

lines.en: : {i}Then...Thaum is...dead{/i}?
lines.zh: : {i}那么……Thaum 已经……死了{/i}？

lines.en: : Nay, just forced back. But his army reduced to mere nothing.
lines.zh: : 不，只是被逼退了。不过他的大军已经化为乌有。

lines.en: : The Satyr speaks the truth.
lines.zh: : 这位萨特说的是实情。

lines.en: : You must have me confused with someone else.
lines.zh: : 您一定是把我跟别人搞混了。

lines.en: : I’ve never even come to this town before.
lines.zh: : 我以前从未来过这座城。

lines.en: : Bacawk.
scene seconddnd34
: You...you know the aarakocra can speak common as well, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你……你知道鹰身人也会说通用语吧？

lines.en: : You don’t always have to talk like a bird.
lines.zh: : 你不用非得像鸟那样说话。

lines.en: : Urrheak never learned common.
lines.zh: : Urrheak 从没学过通用语。

lines.en: : R...Right...
: But anyway...
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来……

lines.en: scene seconddnd35
: {i}If...if what you say is true and the first line has already been pushed back...then...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}如果……如果你们说的是真的，而第一道防线已经被击退了……那么……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Then it’s only a matter of time before...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那么……就只是时间问题了{/i}

lines.en: scene seconddnd36
: The woman takes several steps back, tripping over a park bench and tumbling into the cart of a food vendor.
lines.zh: 女人连退几步，被公园长椅绊了一下，一头栽进了一个小吃贩的推车里。

lines.en: : But just as the vendor is about to cry out in a fit of rage after having his product destroyed, the woman violently grips her head and begins ripping out large clumps of her hair.
lines.zh: 可就在摊贩眼看货物被毁、正要暴怒地大叫时，那女人猛地抱住自己的头，开始大把大把地扯下头发。

lines.en: : She lets out a pained scream as if she’s being consumed from the inside out.
lines.zh: 她发出一声痛苦的尖叫，仿佛正从内到外被什么东西吞噬。

lines.en: scene seconddnd37
: {i}NGAHHHHH! I...I CAN FEEL HIM!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啊啊啊啊啊！我……我能感觉到他！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}STAY...BACK! I CAN’T...FIGHT IT ANY LONGER!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}退……退后！我……再也压制不住它了！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Blahhhhhgababababababa!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啊啊啊嘎嘎嘎嘎嘎嘎嘎！{/i}

lines.en: scene seconddnd38
: The woman suddenly turns into a mushroom. Go ahead and roll for initiative.
lines.zh: : 那女人突然变成了一朵蘑菇。各位，请掷先攻。

lines.en: scene seconddnd39
: The fungus returns!
lines.zh: : 真菌回来了！

lines.en: : Run, friends! Escape while you still can!
lines.zh: : 快跑，朋友们！趁还能逃的时候赶紧逃！

lines.en: : Are there any enemies in this game other than different types of mushrooms?
lines.zh: : 这游戏里除了各种各样的蘑菇，到底还有没有别的敌人？

lines.en: : One can only hope.
lines.zh: : 只能这么指望了。

lines.en: : They won’t last much longer at this rate.
lines.zh: : 照这个速度，它们撑不了多久了。

lines.en: : And neither will I.
lines.zh: : 我也是。

lines.en: : I’m going to head out.
lines.zh: : 我先走了。

lines.en: scene seconddnd40
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : But then who will I talk to?
lines.zh: : 那我跟谁说话去？

lines.en: : What’s this I hear about heading out?
lines.zh: : 我怎么听见有人说要走？

lines.en: scene seconddnd41
: Are you not having a good time, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您玩得不尽兴吗，先生？

lines.en: : I’m sorry. If I’d have known you’d be appearing tonight, I wouldn’t have scheduled our next session when I did.
lines.zh: : 对不起。如果我知道您今晚会来，我就不会把下一次团安排在这个时候了。

lines.en: : Oh, I’m not asking you to call it off or anything.
lines.zh: : 哦，我可不是要你取消什么的。

lines.en: : Don’t let me get in the way of your fun. This sort of thing just isn’t for me.
lines.zh: : 别因为我就扫了大家的兴。这种东西本来就不适合我。

lines.en: : Do you...not even want to try?
lines.zh: : 您……连试都不想试吗？

lines.en: : There are plenty of things I never expected to like that I absolutely love now...And I never would have known that if I didn’t give them a chance.
lines.zh: : 有很多东西我以前从没想过会喜欢，现在却爱得不得了……而如果我没给它们机会，我永远也不会知道。

lines.en: : Granted, they’re all different doujinshi tags and that doesn’t really apply to this conversation, but I’m sure you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 当然了，那些全都是同人志的不同标签，跟现在这个话题其实不太搭，但我想您一定明白我的意思。

lines.en: : I don’t. Please explain.
lines.zh: : 我不明白。请解释一下。

lines.en: : When you’re older, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 等你再大点就懂了，剑道公主。

lines.en: : Yes, Emerald Guardian. I understand.
lines.zh: : 是，翡翠守护者。我明白了。

lines.en: : Maybe some other time. I’m just going to head out now, though.
lines.zh: : 也许改天吧。不过我现在准备走了。

lines.en: : As for Tsuneyo-
lines.zh: : 至于 Tsuneyo——

lines.en: : She’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 她会没事的。

lines.en: scene seconddnd42
: Come sit at the table with us. We’re starting combat in a minute or two and I’ll try teaching you how that works again.
lines.zh: : 过来跟我们坐一会儿吧。再过一两分钟就要开战了，我再试着给你讲讲战斗怎么打。

lines.en: scene seconddnd43
: Sorry you didn’t have fun, Sir.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉您玩得不尽兴，先生。

lines.en: : I was hoping it would be exciting enough for everyone, but it seems I may have failed you.
lines.zh: : 我本来希望这能让每个人都觉得足够刺激，可看来我还是没能让您满意。

lines.en: : Again, don’t be too hard on yourself. It’s just a personal interest thing.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，别太苛责自己。这只是个人兴趣的问题。

lines.en: : Maybe some other time.
lines.zh: : 也许改天吧。

lines.en: : Okay. Maybe some other time...
lines.zh: : 好的。也许改天……

lines.en: scene black
I get up off the stool and say goodbye to all of the girls, exiting the cafe and starting my journey back.
lines.zh: 我从凳子上站起身，跟所有女孩道别，走出咖啡馆，踏上回程。

lines.en: I hope Molly doesn't take my early departure too personally.
lines.zh: 希望 Molly 不会把我的提前离场太往心里去。

lines.en: I understand why she’d be upset that I’m not interested in the same things as her but, at the same time, she should have probably realized that by now.
lines.zh: 我理解她为什么会因为我跟她兴趣不同而难过，但同时，她大概早该意识到这一点了。

lines.en: Liking different things is fine, though.
lines.zh: 不过，喜欢的东西不一样其实也没什么。

lines.en: It gives me more time to...
lines.zh: 这让我有更多时间去……

lines.en: Aimlessly wander around town and think about all of the other things I could have done with my night.
lines.zh: 漫无目的地在城里闲逛，想想这个晚上本可以用来做些别的什么。

lines.en: Oh well, I guess.
lines.zh: 唉，算了。

lines.en: At least all of the girls seem to be having a good time.
lines.zh: 至少所有的女孩看起来都很开心。

{i}Molly's affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}
